about: Hand fixes, applied on every import so a re-import keeps them. Keyed by scheme id (see `winsounds list --ids`). Per scheme: "name" renames it; "events" sets event -> filename or list of filenames (original filenames, as in the source folder; an empty list clears the event); "hide": true keeps it out of `winsounds list`.

windows-10.note: Windows 10 and 11 use Background for Default Beep, Asterisk and Exclamation, Foreground for Critical Stop.
